auth.panelTitle: Every branch. Every expense. One clear view.
auth.panelBody: A single, secure workspace for branch expenses, vendor invoices and approvals.
auth.panelPoint1: Role-based access enforced on every request
auth.panelPoint2: Every approval and payment recorded in the audit trail
auth.typeUserBody: Record and track your own branch expenses
auth.terms: I agree to the Expenvia terms of use and acknowledge that my account will be reviewed by an administrator before access is granted.
auth.passwordHint: At least 10 characters, including a letter and a number.
auth.signInBody: Welcome back. Enter your credentials to continue.
auth.signUpBody: New accounts are reviewed by an administrator before access is granted.
auth.invalidCredentials: The email or password is incorrect.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
auth.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try signing in instead.
auth.genericError: We couldn't complete that request. Please try again.
auth.forgotBody: Enter your account email and we'll prepare a secure reset link.
auth.forgotDone: If an account exists for that email, a password reset link has been issued. It expires in 60 minutes.
auth.resetBody: Your new password will sign you out of every other device.
auth.resetDone: Your password has been updated. Please sign in with your new password.
auth.resetInvalid: This reset link is invalid or has expired. Request a new one.
auth.verifyBody: We need to confirm <email></email> belongs to you before your request is reviewed.
auth.verifyConfirmBody: Confirm your email address to continue your registration.
auth.verifyResent: A verification email has been queued.
auth.verifyInvalid: This verification link is invalid or has expired.
auth.verifyDone: Email verified. Your request is now with an administrator.
auth.devMailNotice: Development mode: no email is delivered. The email worker creates private local previews; ask your local administrator for the link.
auth.pendingTitle: Your account is awaiting administrator approval.
auth.pendingBody: An administrator will review your request. You'll be able to access your dashboard as soon as it's approved.
auth.stillPending: Still under review. We'll keep your place in the queue.
auth.rejectedBody: Your account request was not approved. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your organization's administrator.
auth.suspendedBody: Your account has been suspended by an administrator. Contact your organization's administrator to restore access.
auth.registrationNeutral: If this address is eligible for registration, a verification email has been queued. If you already have an account, sign in or reset your password.

devAccess.title: Development quick access
devAccess.body: Create a ready-to-use account with any name, email and password, then explore the app immediately.
devAccess.warning: Development only. This skips registration review and is disabled automatically in production (ALLOW_DEV_ACCOUNTS).
devAccess.roleAdminBody: Everything: dashboards, approvals, branches, reports, audit log
devAccess.roleUserBody: Record and track your own expenses
devAccess.passwordHint: Any password with at least 6 characters (development only).
devAccess.link: Create a test account · Super Admin, Employee or Vendor
devAccess.adminHelp: Choose Super Admin to open /admin/dashboard with approvals, branches, users, vendors, reports and settings. Employee and Vendor have separate workspaces; create another test account with a different email to explore each. Later, use your email and password on the normal sign-in page.
